title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（林晃生研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Hayashi Akio)
teachers:
HAYASHI Akio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn technical mechanisms and new mechanisms required to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products using the basic knowledge learned in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.(2) Acquire the ability to identify and solve problems in mechanical engineering-related fields. (3) Learn the importance of collaboration, particularly with local communities.
advice:
This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

Our laboratory promotes design projects for solving problems in manufacturing and machine tool operation. We also propose and develop new machine tools and CAD/CAM systems to improve machining accuracy.
To achieve these goals, we want to facilitate the students engaging in Design Project III to always try to understand and apply knowledge. In addition, we participate in technical cooperation with neighboring machine tool manufacturers for co-creation education.
requiredKnowledge: Our laboratory aims to develop new machine tools, CAD/CAM systems, and methods to achieve high-accuracy and high-speed machining. Furthermore, we aim to utilize IoT and save energy in manufacturing fields. Our goal is to train mechanical engineers who are familiar with measurement, control, and evaluation methods. Prior to the start of this course, it is desirable to thoroughly review related courses, such as those of mathematics, Dynamics of Machines II, machining, measurement engineering, and control engineering.

activityGoals.body: Be able to advance your project in accordance with the engineering design process.
Be able to compile the results correctly into an article and discuss the content through presentations.
Be able to act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content.
(3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. The final results can be compiled into the final report and presented to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board.
(3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices if necessary.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

Our laboratory promotes design projects for solving problems in manufacturing and machine tool operation. We also propose and develop new machine tools and CAD/CAM systems to improve machining accuracy.
To achieve these goals, we want to facilitate the students engaging in Design Project III to always try to understand and apply knowledge. In addition, we participate in technical cooperation with neighboring machine tool manufacturers for co-creation education.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Our laboratory aims to develop new machine tools, CAD/CAM systems, and methods to achieve high-accuracy and high-speed machining. Furthermore, we aim to utilize IoT and save energy in manufacturing fields. Our goal is to train mechanical engineers who are familiar with measurement, control, and evaluation methods. Prior to the start of this course, it is desirable to thoroughly review related courses, such as those of mathematics, Dynamics of Machines II, machining, measurement engineering, and control engineering.
